<!--
Data readiness report of hcesfort (use_report_template()). It answers:
can this survey support the analysis, and what is left to do before it
can? Inputs and choices live in _inputs.R, shared with results.qmd; do not
set them here. Edit the title above and the free text below; guidance for
the analyst stays in comments like this one and never reaches the output.
Every exhibit is printed by show_exhibit() with the ID of exhibits.csv;
titles, notes and sentences come from terms.csv.
Design: docs/design-reports-v3.md of the package, section 4.
-->

```{r setup}
writeLines(utils::capture.output(utils::sessionInfo()),
           "readiness-sessionInfo.txt")
source("_inputs.R", local = TRUE)
source("_chain.R", local = TRUE)
source("_tables.R", local = TRUE)
source("_figures.R", local = TRUE)
source("_exhibits.R", local = TRUE)
source("_readiness.R", local = TRUE)
source("_verdict.R", local = TRUE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(results = "asis")
```

## 1. Verdict

```{r verdict}
show_exhibit("D1")
```

## 2. Variables

```{r variables}
show_exhibit("D2")
if (!ready) {
  print_sentences(fill(term("not_ready", "sentence"),
                       inputs = collapse(absent)))
  knitr::knit_exit()
}
```

## 3. Minimum quantity and quality of the data

```{r checks}
show_exhibit("D3")
```

## 4. Linkage ladder

```{r ladder}
show_exhibit("D4")
```

## 5. Work queue

```{r queue}
show_exhibit("D5")
if (nrow(queue) > 0) show_exhibit("D6")
```

## 6. Stopping rule and its cost

```{r stopping}
show_exhibit("D7")
show_unlinked_domains()
```

## 7. Energy plausibility

```{r energy}
if (is.null(energy_column)) {
  print_sentences(term("no_energy", "sentence"))
} else {
  show_exhibit("D9")
}
```

## 8. Decisions taken with the data

```{r decisions}
show_exhibit("D10")
```

## Appendix

```{r appendix}
show_exhibit("DA1")
```
